function onCreate()
  -- manages the hud showing the top 3 session scores
  hiscore = {}
end

function onUpdate(dt)
  updateSessionHiscores()
end

function formatScoreRow(name, score)
  return string.upper(string.sub(name, 1, 24)) .. "    " .. score
end

function updateSessionHiscores()
  local endscore = 4
  local roundover = false
  
  -- add/update current score in table
  local queen = castle.actorsWithTag("queen")[1]
  local name
  if queen ~= nil then 
    name = queen:getSharedOwnerUsername()
    if name ~= nil and #name > 0 then
      local score = queen.variables["queen-ko"]
      -- if not score > 0 then score = 0 end
      hiscore[name] = score
      if score >= endscore then roundover = true end 
    end
  end

  -- make sorted copy for rendering
  local sorted = {}
  for name, score in pairs(hiscore) do
    table.insert(sorted, { name, score })
  end
  table.sort(sorted, function(a,b)
      -- descending
      return a[2] > b[2]
    end
  )

  local foundCurrentQueen = false
  for i=1,3 do
    local txt = castle.actorsWithTag("hiscore")[i]
    local crown = castle.actorsWithTag("hud-crown")[i]
    if txt ~= nil then
      if #sorted >= i then 
        local score = sorted[i]
        local scoreName = score[1]
        txt.text.content = formatScoreRow(scoreName, score[2])
        if name ~= nil and scoreName == name then
          foundCurrentQueen = true
          crown:addTag("ready")
        else 
          crown:removeTag("ready")
        end
      else
        txt.text.content = ""
        -- crown.layout.visible = false
      end
    end
  end

  -- always show current queen in third if not yet in top 3
  if name ~= nil and not foundCurrentQueen then
    local txt = castle.actorsWithTag("hiscore")[3]
    local crown = castle.actorsWithTag("hud-crown")[3]
    txt.text.content = formatScoreRow(name, hiscore[name])
    crown:addTag("ready")
  end

  if roundover then onRoundOver() end
end

function onMessage(message, triggeringActor) end

function onRoundOver()
  my:addTag("round-over")
end

function onCreate()
  -- manages the hud showing the top 3 session scores
  hiscore = {}
end

function onUpdate(dt)
  updateSessionHiscores()
end

function formatWinnerName(name)
  return string.sub(name, 1, 16)
end

function formatScoreRow(name, score)
  return string.upper(string.sub(name, 1, 24)) .. "    " .. score
end

function updateSessionHiscores()
  -- make table of all scores
  local players = castle.actorsWithTag("hero")
  for _, player in ipairs(players) do
    local name
    if player ~= nil then 
      name = player:getSharedOwnerUsername()
      if name ~= nil and #name > 0 then
        local score = player.variables["score"]
        hiscore[name] = score
      end
    end
  end

  -- make sorted copy for rendering
  local sorted = {}
  for name, score in pairs(hiscore) do
    table.insert(sorted, { name, score })
  end
  table.sort(sorted, function(a,b)
      -- descending
      return a[2] > b[2]
    end
  )

  for i=1,3 do
    local txt = castle.actorsWithTag("hiscore")[i]
    local crown = castle.actorsWithTag("crown")[i]
    if txt ~= nil then
      if #sorted >= i then 
        local score = sorted[i]
        local scoreName = score[1]
        txt.text.content = formatScoreRow(scoreName, score[2])
        crown:addTag("ready")

        if i == 1 then
          local winner = castle.actorsWithTag("winner")[1]
          winner.text.content = formatWinnerName(scoreName)
        end
      else
        txt.text.content = ""
        crown.layout.visible = false
      end
    end
  end
end

function onMessage(message, triggeringActor) end
